svg.title: ai-error-explainer, VS Code extension by Robin Ryan
svg.desc: VS Code extension page for ai-error-explainer: AI-powered error explanations on hover. 10 installs. Provider directory with Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, Together AI and xAI Grok.

g.text: That's it — no Base URL or Model needed.
Groq — Advanced Setup (fast, generous free tier)
OpenRouter — Advanced Setup (access hundreds of models, free & paid)
Not seeing your provider? Any service offering an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint will likely work — just fill in its
Base URL and Model name the same way as above.
